<!-- pr-reviewer: 2fbe362baedd36874573bdd65fd6afd6e5cf514d -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- The prior reader is equivalent to the old one, line by line. `Columns::of_grid` copies `x0/y0/cell/nx/ny` straight from the `Dexel`. `Columns::col` is the `Dexel::col` formula (same divide, same bounds, same truncation), and the only difference is that a NaN now returns `None` where it used to give column 0. `prior_surface` already rejects a non-finite `q`, and the cell centres are finite, so that path is unreachable and in any case errs on the side of refusing.
- `center` is the same expression as `Dexel::center`. `top_at(ix, iy)` goes through `Dexel::top_at(ix + iy*nx)` after an in-range check that `col` already guarantees.
- `prior_surface` keeps the same guards and the same `rr`, floor/ceil/clamp window, disc test, `q`-cell seed and NaN-to-`None` handling. `acquit_by_prior` is untouched apart from its type. The acquittal can therefore never be looser than before: same cells, same heights, same `z_tol`, and off-grid still reads as air.
- `Source::{Grid, Field}` is a clean internal split. The `Stock::Column` arm now reuses `of_grid`.
- Both call sites (drill_prior.rs:66 and generate.rs:2795) just wrap the existing `Dexel`. Provenance, decision file and `Changelog: none` are all present, and no `CHANGELOG.md` edit.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main, no conflicts)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim` (all targets) | 348 passed, 0 failed, 3 ignored |
| sim `prior_columns` | 2/2 |
| sim `verify::prior` unit tests | pass, unchanged |
| app `drill_prior` | 12/12 |
| app `drill_reach` | 6/6 |
| app `carried_verify` | 8/8 |
| app `setup_carry` | 9/9 |
| app `suppressed_rest` | 2/2 |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The PR's "stock_columns 3" is a sim test (not an app test); it ran inside the full sim run above. UI was not touched, so the ui suites were not run.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `Columns::center/origin/cell` are new public API with no other caller yet; fine as step 2 of 6.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
